parameters.content: ## 1. Document Source (replaceable)\n\n`Company Documents (Source)` emits one item per document `{ title, category, text }`. Swap it for an HTTP Request, Google Drive, or Extract from File source without changing the rest of the pipeline.

## 2. Chunk -> Embed -> Store (RAG)

Empty documents are skipped. Each document is chunked (Recursive splitter, 800/100), embedded with Google Gemini `text-embedding-004` (768 dims), and upserted into **pgvector table `knowledge_chunks`** (content column `chunk_text`, metadata carries `title` + `category`).

**The main support agent retrieval tool MUST use table `knowledge_chunks`.**

// Expanded company knowledge base covering all customer support domains.
const docs = [
  { title: 'General Support Hours & Contact Info', category: 'FAQ', text: 'Support hours are Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM EST. Weekend support is available via email ticket escalation. International shipping takes 7-14 business days depending on customs.' },

Please note customs, import duties, and VAT taxes are calculated at checkout or charged by local postal authorities depending on regional import laws.' },
  { title: '30-Day Refund & Return Policy', category: 'Refund', text: 'We offer a 30-day full refund guarantee on all hardware products. Items must be returned in original packaging with included accessories. Digital subscriptions are refundable within 14 days of initial purchase if unused.' },
  { title: 'Return Shipping & Processing Timeline', category: 'Refund', text: 'To initiate a return, request a prepaid shipping label from support. Once your return package is delivered to our warehouse, inspecting and processing your refund to your original payment method takes 5 to 10 business days.' },
  { title: 'Subscription Cancellation Policy', category: 'Cancellation', text: 'You can cancel your subscription at any time directly from Account Settings -> Billing -> Cancel Subscription, or by asking our support team. Cancellation takes effect at the end of your current paid billing period.' },
  { title: 'Order Cancellation Before Shipment', category: 'Cancellation', text: 'Physical product orders can be cancelled for a 100% full refund before they enter the Shipped status. Once an order has shipped, it cannot be cancelled but can be returned under our 30-day money-back guarantee.' },
  { title: 'Hardware 2-Year Limited Warranty', category: 'Warranty', text: 'All new Widget Pro devices come with a 2-year limited manufacturer warranty against defects in materials and workmanship. If your device malfunctions under normal use, we will repair or replace it free of charge.' },
  { title: 'Accidental Damage & Extended Warranty', category: 'Warranty', text: 'The standard 2-year warranty covers hardware defects but does not cover water damage, drops, or unauthorized modifications. Optional Extended Protection ($29/year) covers accidental drops and liquid spills.' },
  { title: 'Account Security, Password Reset & 2FA', category: 'Account', text: 'Manage security under Account Settings -> Security. You can enable Two-Factor Authentication (2FA) via Authenticator App (Google/Authy) or SMS. If you forget your password, click Forgot Password on the login screen to receive a secure reset link via email.' },
  { title: 'Team Permissions & User Invites', category: 'Account', text: 'Professional and Enterprise account owners can invite team members under Settings -> Team. Available roles include Admin (full control), Editor (can edit workflows & integrations), and Viewer (read-only monitoring access).' },
  { title: 'Troubleshooting LED Error Light Codes', category: 'Troubleshooting', text: 'LED Status Indicators: Solid Blue = Connected & Ready. Flashing Blue = Pairing Mode. Flashing Red = Low Battery (charge device). Solid Red = Hardware Error (hold power button 10 seconds to factory reset).' },
  { title: 'Offline Sync & Memory Buffer', category: 'Troubleshooting', text: 'If Wi-Fi drops, Widget Pro automatically stores up to 48 hours of event data in internal flash memory buffer. Once internet connectivity is restored, cached logs sync automatically without data loss.' },
  { title: 'REST API & Webhooks Integration', category: 'API', text: 'We provide a REST API (v2) and Webhook events for custom integrations. API Keys can be generated under Developer Settings. Rate limit is 1,000 requests per minute per API key on Professional plans, and 10,000 requests/min on Enterprise.' },
  { title: 'Data Privacy, GDPR & Security Compliance', category: 'Terms', text: 'We are SOC 2 Type II certified and fully compliant with GDPR and CCPA privacy standards. Customer data is encrypted at rest using AES-256 and in transit using TLS 1.3. We never sell customer personal data to third parties.' },
  { title: 'Terms of Service & Terms of Use', category: 'Terms', text: 'By accessing our platform, you agree to our Terms of Use. Accounts are intended for registered individuals or organizations. Misuse, abuse, automated scraping, or unauthorized access attempts may lead to immediate account suspension.' }

return docs.map(d => ({ json: d }));
